ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: NatureLens uses the camera only when you choose to photograph nature for identification.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: NatureLens accesses only the photos you choose for nature identification.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: NatureLens uses approximate location only when you request local climate context.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: NatureLens uses the microphone only when you choose to record a nature sound for identification.
